card.line: Peniel, also spelled Penuel, is the place near the Jabbok where Jacob wrestled with God and was blessed, and where he named it "face of God."

moments.title: Jacob names Peniel
moments.text: God blessed Jacob there. Jacob named the place Peniel because he had seen God face to face and his life was spared.

moments.title: Jacob leaves limping
moments.text: The sun rose as Jacob passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip. To this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the hip socket.
